most_fragile.coverage_caveat: This interval is a RAW percentile bootstrap, not a calibrated 95% CI. flipbudget's own coverage simulation (see the repo's T3 commit history) found ~0.90-0.92 empirical coverage against a 0.95 nominal target at realistic audit densities (n=20-50 per model), improving toward nominal as audit size grows. Report the interval as-is with this caveat, not as an exact 95% CI -- that would be a stronger claim than the evidence supports.
